name: Spirit of Silverpine Log
summary: The Spirit of Silverpine Log is the captain’s record from a ship wrecked in Arathi’s reef. Its charts and log hold information the crew wants kept from enemy hands.

sections.title: The Wrecked Ships
sections.body: First Mate Nilzlix wants the ship’s log and charts recovered before the crew leaves the cove. The Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden’s Folly ran aground when the tide fell, striking what seemed to be a temple in the reef. Both ships sank quickly. Their records now matter to the command in Booty Bay, which fears the information could reach its enemies.

faq.q: What is the Spirit of Silverpine Log?
faq.answer: It is the captain’s log book from the Spirit of Silverpine, one of the ships wrecked in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where did the Spirit of Silverpine sink?
faq.answer: The Spirit of Silverpine ran aground on what seemed to be a temple in the reef at a cove in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Nilzlix want the log?
faq.answer: First Mate Nilzlix wants the Spirit of Silverpine’s log and charts recovered before the crew leaves, so their information does not fall into enemy hands.

faq.q: What happened to the Spirit of Silverpine?
faq.answer: As the tide lowered, the Spirit of Silverpine ran aground on what seemed to be a temple in the reef and sank quickly.

faq.q: Why are the charts and logs important?
faq.answer: The crew fears the records could fall into enemy hands, and Fleet Master Seahorn would hold them responsible if that happened.
